seoDescription: Buy genuine laptops, desktop PCs and mini PCs in Nepal for study, work and gaming. Compare specs and order with cash on delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy laptops and desktop computers in Nepal

The right computer depends on what you do every day. Students need something light with a long battery life, office users want a comfortable keyboard and reliable performance, and gamers and creators need a strong graphics card and good cooling.

## Laptop, desktop or mini PC?

- Laptops: portable and self-contained, with a battery that keeps working during power cuts
- Desktop PCs: more performance for the money, easy to upgrade and repair
- Mini PCs: desktop performance in a box small enough to mount behind a monitor

## Specifications that matter

- Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better for smooth multitasking
- RAM: 16 GB is the comfortable standard today; 8 GB is the minimum
- Storage: an NVMe SSD makes the whole computer feel fast; 512 GB or more is ideal
- Graphics: integrated graphics are fine for study and office work; a dedicated GPU is needed for gaming and video editing
- Display: Full HD or higher, and a brighter, colour-accurate panel for design work

faqs.question: How much RAM does a laptop need?
faqs.answer: 8 GB handles browsing, documents and online classes. 16 GB is better for multitasking, programming, photo editing and keeping the laptop useful for longer. Gamers and video editors benefit from 16 to 32 GB.

faqs.question: Is an SSD really necessary?
faqs.answer: Yes. An SSD makes a computer start up in seconds and open apps far faster than a hard drive. All modern laptops worth buying use an SSD as the main drive.

faqs.question: Should I buy a laptop or a desktop?
faqs.answer: Choose a laptop if you need to carry it or want it to keep running through power cuts. Choose a desktop if you work in one place and want the most performance for your budget, or easy upgrades later.

seoDescription: Shop genuine laptops in Nepal: student, business and gaming laptops from top brands. Full specs, cash on delivery, nationwide delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy laptops in Nepal

A laptop is an investment you will rely on for years of study or work, so it pays to match it to how you will use it. We stock genuine laptops for students, professionals, creators and gamers.

## Choosing a laptop by use

- Students: a light laptop with long battery life, 8 to 16 GB RAM and an SSD
- Office and business: a comfortable keyboard, a good webcam, solid build and enough ports
- Programming and design: 16 GB RAM or more, a fast processor and a sharp, colour-accurate display
- Gaming: a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX or AMD Radeon graphics card, a high refresh rate screen and strong cooling

## Checklist before you buy

- Processor generation, not just the name (a newer Core i5 can beat an older Core i7)
- RAM type and whether it can be upgraded
- SSD size and whether there is a spare slot
- Screen size, resolution, brightness and refresh rate
- Battery life, weight and charger type (USB-C charging is convenient)
- Ports: USB-A, USB-C, HDMI and a headphone jack

Every laptop at 361 Gadgets is a genuine product with its full specifications listed on the product page.

faqs.question: Which laptop is best for students in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Look for a light laptop with an Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or newer equivalent), at least 8 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and good battery life. That covers online classes, assignments and programming for several years.

faqs.question: What should I look for in a gaming laptop?
faqs.answer: A dedicated graphics card is the most important part, followed by the processor, 16 GB RAM, a 120 Hz or faster display and a cooling system that keeps the laptop stable during long sessions.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade the RAM or SSD later?
faqs.answer: Many laptops have a spare SSD slot or replaceable RAM, but thin models often have RAM soldered to the board. Check the specifications, or ask us about a particular model before buying.

faqs.question: Does the laptop come with Windows?
faqs.answer: It depends on the model. The product page states the operating system that comes installed.

seoDescription: Buy genuine desktop PCs in Nepal for office, study and gaming. Powerful, upgradable computers from trusted brands, delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy desktop PCs in Nepal

A desktop PC gives you more performance per rupee than a laptop, and it is easy to upgrade: add more RAM, a bigger SSD or a new graphics card when you need it. It is the practical choice for offices, family computers, students who study at home and gamers.

## Choosing a desktop PC

- Office and home: a recent Core i3/i5 or Ryzen 3/5, 8 to 16 GB RAM and an SSD
- Creative work: a stronger processor, 32 GB RAM and a graphics card for video and 3D
- Gaming: a dedicated graphics card matched to your monitor's resolution and refresh rate

## Plan for power cuts

Unlike laptops, desktops switch off immediately when the power goes. A UPS keeps the PC running long enough to save your work and shut down safely, and protects it from voltage fluctuations. See our UPS section to pair one with your PC.

faqs.question: Do I need a UPS for a desktop PC?
faqs.answer: In Nepal it is strongly recommended. A UPS keeps the PC running for a few minutes during power cuts and protects it from voltage drops and spikes that can corrupt data or damage parts.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade a desktop PC later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most desktops let you add RAM, storage and a better graphics card. Check the power supply wattage and the case size before buying a large graphics card.

faqs.question: Does a desktop come with a monitor, keyboard and mouse?
faqs.answer: Not always. The product page lists exactly what is included. You can add a monitor, keyboard and mouse from our peripherals section.

seoDescription: Shop genuine mini PCs in Nepal: compact, energy-efficient desktop computers for office, home media and study.
seoContent:
## Buy mini PCs in Nepal

Mini PCs pack a full desktop computer into a box the size of a book. They use far less power than a tower PC, run quietly, and can be mounted behind a monitor or TV to keep a desk completely clear.

## What mini PCs are good for

- Office work, browsing and online classes
- A home media centre connected to a TV
- Reception desks, shops and point-of-sale systems
- Light programming and home servers

## What to check

- Processor and whether RAM and SSD are included or sold separately (barebone)
- Video outputs (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C) and how many monitors it supports
- USB ports, Ethernet and Wi-Fi
- VESA mount support if you want it behind a monitor

Low power use also makes mini PCs a good match for a small UPS during power cuts.

faqs.question: Is a mini PC powerful enough for office work?
faqs.answer: Yes. A modern mini PC with a recent Intel or AMD processor, 8 to 16 GB RAM and an SSD handles office software, browsing, video calls and multitasking comfortably.

faqs.question: Can a mini PC run games?
faqs.answer: Light and older games, yes, especially on models with recent AMD Ryzen chips that have strong integrated graphics. For demanding modern games, a desktop or laptop with a dedicated graphics card is better.

faqs.question: What does barebone mean?
faqs.answer: A barebone mini PC comes without RAM, storage or an operating system, so you add your own. The product page states whether these are included.

seoDescription: Buy genuine PC components in Nepal: processors, graphics cards, motherboards, RAM, SSDs and hard drives for building or upgrading a PC.
seoContent:
## Buy PC components in Nepal

Building or upgrading a PC lets you put the budget where it matters for you: a stronger graphics card for gaming, more RAM for editing, or a fast SSD that makes an old computer feel new. Genuine parts matter here more than anywhere, because fake or recycled components cause crashes and fail early.

## Components in this section

- Processors (CPUs) from Intel and AMD
- Graphics cards (GPUs) for gaming and creative work
- Motherboards for each CPU socket and chipset
- RAM: DDR4 and DDR5 desktop and laptop memory
- SSDs: NVMe and SATA solid state drives
- Hard drives (HDD) for large, low-cost storage

## Check compatibility first

The processor socket must match the motherboard, the RAM type (DDR4 or DDR5) must match the board, and the power supply must have enough wattage for the graphics card. If you are unsure, contact us with your parts list before you order.

faqs.question: How do I know if parts are compatible?
faqs.answer: Match the CPU socket to the motherboard (for example AM5 or LGA1700), the RAM generation to the motherboard, and check the power supply wattage and case size for the graphics card. We can help check a parts list for you.

faqs.question: What is the most effective upgrade for an old PC?
faqs.answer: Replacing a hard drive with an SSD is usually the biggest improvement, followed by adding RAM. For gaming, the graphics card makes the most difference.

faqs.question: Are your components new and original?
faqs.answer: Yes. All components are genuine, new products, not used or recycled parts.

seoDescription: Shop genuine Intel and AMD processors in Nepal: Core and Ryzen CPUs for gaming, work and PC builds. Delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy processors (CPUs) in Nepal

The processor is the brain of your PC and decides which motherboard and RAM you can use. Intel Core and AMD Ryzen processors both offer excellent options at every budget.

## How to choose a CPU

- Everyday use and office: Core i3 / Ryzen 3 or a newer Core i5 / Ryzen 5
- Gaming: a modern 6 to 8 core CPU such as Core i5 / Ryzen 5 pairs well with most graphics cards
- Video editing, 3D and streaming: more cores help, so look at Core i7 / i9 or Ryzen 7 / 9
- Integrated graphics: AMD G-series and most Intel models without F include graphics, so you can run without a GPU

## Match the platform

Check the socket (for example Intel LGA1700 or AMD AM4 / AM5) and whether the motherboard supports DDR4 or DDR5 RAM. Some CPUs do not include a cooler, so check the box contents on the product page.

faqs.question: Intel or AMD: which is better?
faqs.answer: Both make excellent processors. Compare the specific models at your budget for the work you do, and factor in the motherboard and RAM costs of each platform.

faqs.question: Does the processor include a cooler?
faqs.answer: Some do and some do not, especially higher-end and unlocked models. The product page states whether a stock cooler is in the box.

faqs.question: What does the F in an Intel CPU name mean?
faqs.answer: F models have no integrated graphics, so you need a separate graphics card to get a display.

seoDescription: Buy genuine graphics cards in Nepal: NVIDIA GeForce RTX and AMD Radeon GPUs for gaming, streaming and creative work.
seoContent:
## Buy graphics cards in Nepal

The graphics card has the biggest effect on gaming performance and speeds up video editing, 3D rendering and AI tools. Choosing the right one comes down to the resolution you play at and the power your PC can supply.

## Choosing a GPU

- 1080p gaming: an entry to mid-range card handles most games at high settings
- 1440p gaming: a mid to upper-range card with 12 GB or more VRAM
- 4K gaming and heavy creative work: a high-end card with plenty of VRAM
- Features: NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR boost frame rates; NVIDIA CUDA is widely supported in creative and AI software

## Before you buy

- Power supply: check the recommended PSU wattage and the power connectors the card needs
- Size: measure the space in your case for card length and thickness
- Monitor: pair the card with a monitor whose resolution and refresh rate it can drive

All graphics cards we sell are genuine and new.

faqs.question: What power supply do I need for a graphics card?
faqs.answer: Each card has a recommended PSU wattage listed by the manufacturer. Use a good-quality power supply that meets or exceeds it and has the right PCIe power connectors.

faqs.question: How much VRAM do I need?
faqs.answer: 8 GB is enough for many games at 1080p. For 1440p, newer games and creative work, 12 to 16 GB gives you more headroom for the next few years.

faqs.question: Will a new graphics card fit my old PC?
faqs.answer: Check three things: the length of the card against your case, the PSU wattage and connectors, and that your motherboard has a PCIe x16 slot. A very old processor may also limit performance.

seoDescription: Shop genuine motherboards in Nepal for Intel and AMD processors: ATX, Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX boards with DDR4 and DDR5 support.
seoContent:
## Buy motherboards in Nepal

The motherboard connects every part of your PC, and it decides which processor, RAM and expansion options you can use. A good board makes building easier and leaves room for upgrades.

## How to choose a motherboard

- Socket and chipset: must match your processor, for example AMD AM5 or Intel LGA1700
- RAM support: DDR4 or DDR5, number of slots and maximum capacity
- Size: ATX for full-size builds, Micro-ATX for compact towers, Mini-ITX for small form factor PCs
- Storage: number of M.2 NVMe slots and SATA ports
- Connectivity: built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, USB-C, and the speed of the network port
- Power delivery: stronger VRMs matter for high-end and overclocked processors

All motherboards are genuine and new, with full specifications on each product page.

faqs.question: Do I need a motherboard with Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: If your PC will not be near the router or you cannot run an Ethernet cable, built-in Wi-Fi is convenient. Otherwise a wired connection is more stable and you can save money.

faqs.question: Can I use DDR4 RAM on a DDR5 motherboard?
faqs.answer: No. DDR4 and DDR5 use different slots. Buy RAM that matches the motherboard's supported type.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ATX and Micro-ATX?
faqs.answer: ATX boards are larger with more expansion slots and ports. Micro-ATX boards fit smaller cases and usually cost less, with fewer slots.

seoDescription: Buy genuine RAM in Nepal: DDR4 and DDR5 desktop and laptop memory to speed up your PC. Original brands, delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy RAM in Nepal

Adding memory is one of the simplest ways to make a slow computer usable again. More RAM lets you keep more browser tabs, apps and games open without the system slowing down.

## How much RAM do you need?

- 8 GB: basic browsing, documents and online classes
- 16 GB: the sweet spot for gaming, programming and multitasking
- 32 GB or more: video editing, 3D, virtual machines and heavy creative work

## Choose the right type

- Desktop RAM (DIMM) and laptop RAM (SO-DIMM) are different sizes
- DDR4 and DDR5 are not interchangeable; match what your motherboard or laptop supports
- Use matched kits (for example 2 x 8 GB) for dual-channel speed
- Speed (MHz) and latency matter less than capacity for most people

All RAM we sell is genuine. Check your motherboard or laptop manual for supported types before ordering.

faqs.question: How do I know which RAM my laptop takes?
faqs.answer: Check the laptop's specifications or manual for the RAM type (DDR4 or DDR5), form factor (SO-DIMM) and maximum supported capacity. Some thin laptops have RAM soldered to the board and cannot be upgraded.

faqs.question: Is 16 GB of RAM enough for gaming?
faqs.answer: Yes, 16 GB is enough for almost all current games. 32 GB helps if you stream, edit video or run many apps alongside your games.

faqs.question: Can I mix different RAM sticks?
faqs.answer: It often works, but the memory will run at the speed of the slowest stick and mismatched modules can cause instability. A matched kit is the safest choice.

seoDescription: Shop genuine SSDs in Nepal: NVMe M.2 and SATA solid state drives that make laptops and PCs boot and load much faster.
seoContent:
## Buy SSDs in Nepal

An SSD is the single most noticeable upgrade for an older computer. Startup takes seconds instead of minutes, apps open instantly and the whole system feels more responsive.

## Types of internal SSDs

- NVMe M.2: the fastest type, plugs directly into the motherboard; PCIe Gen 3 and Gen 4 drives are common
- SATA 2.5-inch: replaces a laptop or desktop hard drive and works with almost any computer
- SATA M.2: the M.2 shape but SATA speeds; check which M.2 type your device supports

## How to choose

- Capacity: 512 GB is a sensible minimum; 1 TB suits gamers and creators
- Compatibility: confirm your laptop or motherboard has the right slot (M.2 NVMe, M.2 SATA or a 2.5-inch bay)
- Endurance: the TBW rating shows how much data the drive is rated to write over its life

All SSDs we sell are genuine and new.

faqs.question: Will an SSD make my old laptop faster?
faqs.answer: Yes. Replacing a hard drive with an SSD is the most effective upgrade for an older laptop. Boot times, app launches and file searches all become much faster.

faqs.question: What is the difference between NVMe and SATA SSDs?
faqs.answer: NVMe SSDs connect over PCIe and can be several times faster than SATA SSDs. SATA SSDs are still much faster than hard drives and work in older devices that lack an NVMe slot.

faqs.question: How do I move my data to a new SSD?
faqs.answer: You can clone your old drive with free tools from many SSD makers, or install a fresh copy of the operating system and copy your files across. Keep a backup before you start.

seoDescription: Buy genuine internal hard drives in Nepal: high-capacity HDDs for desktop storage, backups, NAS and CCTV recording.
seoContent:
## Buy internal hard drives (HDD) in Nepal

Hard drives give you the most storage for your money. They are ideal for keeping large photo and video libraries, game collections, backups and CCTV recordings, while an SSD handles the operating system and apps.

## Choosing a hard drive

- Capacity: 1 to 2 TB for general storage, 4 TB and up for media libraries and backups
- Speed: 7200 RPM drives are faster; 5400 RPM drives are quieter and cooler
- Purpose-built drives: NAS drives for 24/7 storage servers and surveillance drives for CCTV recorders are built for constant use
- Size: 3.5-inch drives for desktops, 2.5-inch drives for laptops and compact systems

## Protect your data

Hard drives are mechanical, so a UPS helps protect them from sudden power cuts, and an external backup of important files is always a good idea.

faqs.question: Should I buy an SSD or an HDD?
faqs.answer: Use an SSD for your operating system and apps for speed, and an HDD for bulk storage where cost per terabyte matters more than speed. Many PCs use both.

faqs.question: Which hard drive is best for CCTV?
faqs.answer: Surveillance-rated drives are designed to record continuously around the clock and handle multiple camera streams, so they last longer than standard desktop drives in a DVR or NVR.

faqs.question: Can I use a desktop hard drive in a laptop?
faqs.answer: No. Desktops use 3.5-inch drives and laptops use 2.5-inch drives. Check the size your device supports.

seoDescription: Shop genuine computer peripherals in Nepal: monitors, keyboards, mice, webcams and printers for home, office and gaming.
seoContent:
## Buy computer peripherals in Nepal

The devices you touch and look at every day make the biggest difference to comfort. A sharp monitor, a keyboard you enjoy typing on and a mouse that fits your hand make long hours of work or study far easier.

## Peripherals in this section

- Monitors: Full HD, QHD and 4K displays, including high refresh rate gaming monitors
- Keyboards: wired and wireless, membrane and mechanical
- Mice: ergonomic, wireless and precision mice
- Webcams: clear video for online classes, interviews and meetings
- Printers: for home, school and office printing

## Build a comfortable setup

Put the top of the monitor at eye level, keep the keyboard and mouse at elbow height, and choose wireless devices to cut cable clutter. All peripherals we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Will these peripherals work with my laptop?
faqs.answer: Most connect over USB, USB-C or Bluetooth and work with Windows, macOS and many with Android and iPad too. The product page lists connection type and supported systems.

faqs.question: Is a wireless keyboard and mouse reliable?
faqs.answer: Yes. Modern 2.4 GHz receivers and Bluetooth are stable and have long battery life. For competitive gaming, choose a low-latency wireless or wired model.

faqs.question: Do you deliver monitors safely outside the valley?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monitors are packed in their original boxes for delivery to every district.

seoDescription: Buy genuine monitors in Nepal: Full HD, QHD and 4K displays, IPS panels and high refresh rate gaming monitors from top brands.
seoContent:
## Buy monitors in Nepal

A good monitor reduces eye strain, gives you more room to work and makes games and videos look their best. Adding a second screen to a laptop is one of the best productivity upgrades you can make.

## How to choose a monitor

- Size and resolution: 24-inch at Full HD (1080p) for everyday use, 27-inch at QHD (1440p) for sharper text, 4K for design and media
- Panel type: IPS for accurate colours and wide viewing angles, VA for deep contrast, fast IPS or TN for competitive gaming
- Refresh rate: 60 to 75 Hz for office work, 144 Hz or higher for smooth gaming
- Connections: HDMI and DisplayPort; USB-C with power delivery can charge a laptop through one cable
- Ergonomics: height adjustment and VESA mount support help posture

All monitors at 361 Gadgets are genuine, with full specifications on each product page.

faqs.question: What monitor size is best for a desk?
faqs.answer: 24 inches suits most desks and Full HD resolution. 27 inches works well at QHD and gives more space for multitasking. Larger or ultrawide monitors need a deeper desk.

faqs.question: Do I need a 144 Hz monitor?
faqs.answer: For gaming, yes: a higher refresh rate makes motion much smoother if your PC can produce the frame rates. For office work and video, 60 to 75 Hz is fine.

faqs.question: Can I connect a monitor to my laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, through HDMI, DisplayPort or USB-C, depending on the ports your laptop has. A USB-C monitor can also charge a compatible laptop over the same cable.

seoDescription: Shop genuine keyboards in Nepal: wireless, mechanical and compact keyboards for office, study and programming.
seoContent:
## Buy keyboards in Nepal

If you type for hours every day, a better keyboard is one of the most worthwhile upgrades. The right one is more comfortable, more accurate and lasts for years.

## Types of keyboards

- Membrane: quiet and affordable, good for offices and shared spaces
- Mechanical: individual switches with a crisp, durable feel, popular with programmers and writers
- Low-profile: slim keys similar to a laptop, comfortable for fast typing
- Wireless: Bluetooth or a 2.4 GHz receiver for a tidy desk; many switch between several devices

## Layout and size

- Full-size with a number pad for accounting and data entry
- Tenkeyless (TKL) and 75 percent layouts save space and keep the mouse closer
- Check compatibility with Windows and macOS key layouts

All keyboards we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is a mechanical keyboard worth it for typing?
faqs.answer: Many people find mechanical keyboards more comfortable and accurate for long typing sessions, and they last much longer. Quieter switch types are available if you share a room or office.

faqs.question: Can one keyboard connect to my laptop and tablet?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-device Bluetooth keyboards can pair with several devices and switch between them with a key.

faqs.question: Do wireless keyboards have lag?
faqs.answer: Not noticeably for typing. For competitive gaming, a wired keyboard or a low-latency 2.4 GHz wireless model is better.

seoDescription: Buy genuine computer mice in Nepal: wireless, ergonomic and silent mice for laptops and desktops. Delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy a computer mouse in Nepal

A good mouse makes work faster and kinder to your wrist than a laptop touchpad. Whether you need a compact mouse for travel or an ergonomic one for all-day use, the right shape matters most.

## How to choose a mouse

- Connection: 2.4 GHz wireless for reliability, Bluetooth to avoid using a USB port, or wired for zero charging
- Shape: ambidextrous, right-handed contoured or vertical ergonomic designs
- Size: match the mouse to your hand size and grip style
- Battery: rechargeable over USB-C or long-life AA / AAA batteries
- Extras: silent clicks for shared spaces, extra side buttons and multi-device switching

For gaming mice with high DPI sensors and programmable buttons, see our gaming mouse section. All mice we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is a vertical mouse better for wrist pain?
faqs.answer: Many people with wrist strain find a vertical mouse more comfortable because it keeps the hand in a natural handshake position. It takes a few days to get used to.

faqs.question: Will a wireless mouse work with a MacBook?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bluetooth mice connect directly. Mice with a USB-A receiver need a USB-C adapter or hub on MacBooks that only have USB-C ports.

faqs.question: How long does a wireless mouse battery last?
faqs.answer: Rechargeable mice often last weeks per charge, and many AA-powered mice last a year or more. The product page lists the brand's figures.

seoDescription: Shop genuine printers in Nepal: inkjet, ink tank and laser printers for home, school and office printing.
seoContent:
## Buy printers in Nepal

The best printer depends on what you print and how often. Students printing assignments, families printing photos and offices printing hundreds of pages a week all need different machines.

## Types of printers

- Ink tank printers: refillable tanks with a very low cost per page, ideal for homes and schools that print regularly
- Inkjet printers: good for occasional colour and photo printing
- Laser printers: fast, sharp black-and-white text and low running costs for offices
- All-in-one: print, scan and copy in one machine

## What to compare

- Cost per page and the price and availability of ink or toner
- Wi-Fi printing from phones and laptops
- Automatic double-sided printing to save paper
- Monthly duty cycle if you print a lot

All printers we sell are genuine products.

faqs.question: Which printer is cheapest to run?
faqs.answer: Ink tank printers usually have the lowest cost per page for colour printing, and mono laser printers are very economical for black text. Cartridge inkjets are cheap to buy but cost more per page.

faqs.question: Can I print from my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a Wi-Fi printer and the brand's app or the built-in printing feature on Android and iPhone.

faqs.question: Is a laser printer better for students?
faqs.answer: If you mostly print text documents, a mono laser printer is fast and cheap per page. If you need colour, an ink tank printer is a better all-rounder.

seoDescription: Buy genuine webcams in Nepal: 1080p and 4K webcams with clear microphones for online classes, meetings and streaming.
seoContent:
## Buy webcams in Nepal

Built-in laptop cameras are often blurry and dark. A dedicated webcam makes you look and sound far better in online classes, job interviews, client meetings and live streams.

## How to choose a webcam

- Resolution: 1080p is the standard for clear video; 2K and 4K add detail for streaming and recording
- Frame rate: 30 fps for calls, 60 fps for smoother streams
- Low-light performance: matters for rooms without good lighting
- Microphone: built-in noise-reducing mics help if you do not use a headset
- Field of view: wider lenses fit more people in the frame for group calls
- Mount: a clip that fits monitors and laptops, and a tripod thread for flexibility
- Privacy: a built-in shutter or cover

All webcams we sell are genuine and work with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and other apps.

faqs.question: Do webcams need drivers?
faqs.answer: Most webcams are plug and play over USB on Windows and macOS. Some brands offer optional software for extra settings.

faqs.question: Is 1080p enough for online classes and meetings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most video call apps send video at 720p or 1080p, so a good 1080p webcam with decent low-light performance is all most people need.

faqs.question: Can I use a webcam with a desktop PC?
faqs.answer: Yes. A webcam is the easiest way to add a camera and microphone to a desktop, which usually has neither built in.

seoDescription: Shop genuine computer accessories in Nepal: laptop bags, cooling pads, USB hubs and docking stations. Delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy computer accessories in Nepal

The right accessories make a laptop more comfortable, more capable and better protected. Modern laptops have fewer ports and run warm under load, so a hub, a dock or a cooling pad can make a big difference.

## Accessories in this section

- Laptop bags and sleeves to protect your laptop on the way to college or work
- Cooling pads that keep gaming and work laptops running cooler and quieter
- USB hubs that add USB-A, HDMI and card reader ports
- Docking stations that connect monitors, network, charging and peripherals through one cable

Check your laptop's ports and size before ordering, and see each product page for compatibility. All accessories we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a USB hub and a docking station?
faqs.answer: A USB hub adds a few extra ports. A docking station is a fuller desk setup that typically adds multiple displays, Ethernet, more USB ports and passes power through to charge the laptop.

faqs.question: Does a cooling pad really help?
faqs.answer: Yes, especially for gaming laptops. Better airflow lowers temperatures, which reduces fan noise and helps the laptop sustain its performance.

faqs.question: Which laptop bag size should I buy?
faqs.answer: Match the bag to your laptop's screen size (for example 14-inch or 15.6-inch) and check the internal compartment dimensions on the product page.

seoDescription: Buy laptop bags and backpacks in Nepal: padded, water-resistant bags for 13 to 17-inch laptops, for college, office and travel.
seoContent:
## Buy laptop bags in Nepal

A laptop bag protects an expensive device from bumps, dust and rain on bus rides, motorbike commutes and trips. A good bag also keeps chargers, notebooks and accessories organised.

## Types of laptop bags

- Backpacks: the most comfortable for commuting and walking, with weight on both shoulders
- Messenger and briefcase bags: a smart look for office and meetings
- Sleeves: slim protection to slip into another bag

## What to look for

- The right size for your laptop's screen size
- A padded laptop compartment, ideally raised from the bottom of the bag
- Water-resistant fabric for monsoon season
- Padded, adjustable straps and back panel
- Pockets for a charger, power bank, cables and documents
- Anti-theft features such as hidden zips for crowded buses

All laptop bags at 361 Gadgets are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a 15.6-inch bag fit a 14-inch laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the laptop may move around. A bag sized for your exact laptop holds it more securely; check the compartment dimensions on the product page.

faqs.question: Are these bags waterproof?
faqs.answer: Many are water-resistant, which protects against light rain. In heavy monsoon rain, a rain cover or keeping the laptop in a sleeve inside the bag adds protection.

faqs.question: Is a backpack better than a shoulder bag?
faqs.answer: For daily commuting and walking, yes: a backpack spreads the weight across both shoulders and leaves your hands free.

seoDescription: Shop laptop cooling pads in Nepal to lower temperatures, reduce fan noise and keep gaming laptops performing at their best.
seoContent:
## Buy laptop cooling pads in Nepal

Laptops, especially gaming laptops, get hot under load. When they overheat they slow themselves down to protect their parts, which you notice as stuttering in games or slower exports. A cooling pad improves airflow so the laptop runs cooler and more consistently.

## What to look for

- Fan size and layout that match where your laptop's intake vents are
- Adjustable fan speed to balance cooling and noise
- Height adjustment, which also raises the screen to a better viewing angle
- Size that fits your laptop (for example up to 15.6 or 17 inches)
- USB passthrough so the pad does not use up a port

A cooling pad also helps on soft surfaces such as beds and sofas, where vents get blocked. All cooling pads we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: How much does a cooling pad lower laptop temperature?
faqs.answer: It depends on the laptop and the pad, but improved airflow typically lowers temperatures by several degrees and reduces how often the laptop throttles.

faqs.question: Is a cooling pad necessary for a gaming laptop?
faqs.answer: It is not required, but it often helps gaming laptops hold higher performance for longer and keeps the keyboard and palm rest cooler.

faqs.question: How is a cooling pad powered?
faqs.answer: Most are powered from one of the laptop's USB ports, and many include a passthrough port so you do not lose that port.

seoDescription: Buy USB hubs in Nepal: USB-C and USB-A hubs with HDMI, card readers and charging to add ports to laptops and MacBooks.
seoContent:
## Buy USB hubs in Nepal

Many modern laptops, especially MacBooks and thin ultrabooks, come with only one or two USB-C ports. A USB hub adds the ports you need for a mouse, pen drive, external monitor, SD card and charger.

## How to choose a USB hub

- Input: USB-C hubs for modern laptops, USB-A hubs for older computers
- Ports: USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, SD and microSD readers, Ethernet and a headphone jack
- Power passthrough: lets you charge the laptop through the hub; check the wattage
- Display output: HDMI resolution and refresh rate, for example 4K at 30 Hz or 60 Hz
- Data speed: USB 3.0 or faster for external drives

Check that your laptop's USB-C port supports video output if you plan to connect a monitor. All hubs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a USB-C hub work with my MacBook?
faqs.answer: Yes. USB-C hubs work with MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models. Note that base Apple silicon MacBooks support a limited number of external displays.

faqs.question: Can I connect a monitor through a USB hub?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a hub that has HDMI or DisplayPort, as long as your laptop's USB-C port supports video output (DisplayPort Alt Mode or Thunderbolt).

faqs.question: Can I charge my laptop through the hub?
faqs.answer: Hubs with power delivery passthrough let you plug your USB-C charger into the hub. The hub uses a little of the power itself, so the laptop receives slightly less than the charger's rating.

seoDescription: Shop docking stations in Nepal: USB-C and Thunderbolt docks for multiple monitors, Ethernet and laptop charging through one cable.
seoContent:
## Buy docking stations in Nepal

A docking station turns a laptop into a full desktop setup with a single cable. Plug in once and you are connected to your monitors, keyboard, mouse, wired internet and charger. It is ideal for people who work at a desk but carry their laptop home.

## What to look for

- Connection: USB-C, or Thunderbolt for the highest bandwidth
- Displays: how many monitors it supports, at what resolution and refresh rate
- Charging: power delivery wattage to charge your laptop
- Ports: USB-A, USB-C, Ethernet, audio and card readers
- Compatibility: Windows, macOS and specific laptop models

Multiple-monitor support depends on your laptop too, so check its specifications. All docking stations we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do I need Thunderbolt for a docking station?
faqs.answer: No. Many docks work over regular USB-C with video output. Thunderbolt docks offer more bandwidth for multiple high-resolution monitors and fast storage.

faqs.question: How many monitors can I connect?
faqs.answer: It depends on both the dock and your laptop. Some laptops, including base Apple silicon MacBooks, support only one or two external displays regardless of the dock.

faqs.question: Will the dock charge my laptop?
faqs.answer: Most docks provide power delivery to charge the laptop. Check that the dock's charging wattage is enough for your laptop.
